items.title: Special cancellation right due to unfavourable price increase
items.quote: Für diese Kündigung haben Sie drei Monate Zeit, gerechnet ab dem Zugang dieser Mitteilung; wirksam wird sie frühestens an dem Tag, an dem der neue Preis gilt.
items.computation: The letter does not state when it was actually received (Zugang), only that the period runs from receipt. As the earliest plausible reading, the start is assumed to be the letter's own date, 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). Under §187 Abs. 2, §188 Abs. 2 BGB, a period of months starting on day X ends on the day bearing the same date number X months later: 21.11.2026 + 3 months = 21.02.2027. That day (21.02.2027) is a Sunday, so under §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 22.02.2027. (If actual receipt was later than the letter's date, the true deadline would be correspondingly later.)
